Callout.Name: Heist Aftermath
Callout.Message: Bank robbery abandoned, suspects fleeing on foot.
Callout.Advisory: Cash on the pavement, three suspects running.

Script.Line: They came out of the back and went on foot through the car park.
Two of them and they are carrying. Take that seriously.
One of them is limping. He went down on the steps and he is limping now.

Lines.Approach: They have dropped half of it and they are running. The money is not the priority.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
